description: This file defines the LocationMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM Admin Menu namespace. The class implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses a trait to assist with module screen handling. Its primary function is to override the current screen to 'viewLocations' when configuring the menu for location management within the admin module of OrangeHRM.

classes.name: LocationMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu options related to location viewing in the admin module. Implements the MenuConfigurator interface and overrides the screen to 'viewLocations' when called.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module and screen to 'viewLocations' by invoking getCurrentModuleAndScreen()->overrideScreen('viewLocations')'. Returns null.
